balls.text: comes down the track, it's a length ball and he senses another big one, lofts it high, really high, but doesn't get the distance, is caught at long-on by the substitute fielder
a wise choice to not take a single the previous ball, short on middle and he latches on to it, getting back and pulling it over deep square leg for another six, Tait's half-century comes up
full outside off, knocked towards extra cover, no single taken this time
low full toss outside off, tries to swing it over midwicket, misses, was there to hit and he'll be disappointed he missed
full on the off stump, stroked to deep cover for a single, Karthik gets on strike
Tait continues to bleed runs, short on middle, goes for the pull, gets a top edge over the keeper, another four
fails to pick the slower one again, gets an inside edge onto the thigh as he goes for the pull, one more
McDonald has picked his spot, bowled it full and he made room to drive that into that gap between long-off and deep extra cover, four more
slower one bowled short again, pulled away to deep square leg for one more
full on the off, digs it out into the off side for a single
short on the off, pulls it away just wide of deep square leg for a couple of runs
short and slow by Trivedi, McDonald is too early into the pull, misses
Three in a row, full outside off and he makes room to caress it past extra cover, three shots in three different directions off three consecutive balls, all to the boundary, Tait has been thwacked
four more, low full toss while aiming for the yorker, not much power involved this time, just drives it wristily to beat mid-on for yet another boundary
full again, on the off stump and he repeats a shot he had pulled off earlier in the innings, hammers it down the ground into the V for another four
Karthik gets to a half-century, an enterprising innings, typical of him, guides that down to third man
a beamer, down the leg side, and Ojha misses it, that's five runs, Tait's been poor this game and he's made a mess of that
full on the pads, tries to flick it fine, gets a single
full outside off, driven wide of extra cover for a couple of runs
Another length ball and by the look of his follow-through, it seemed it would disappear as well but he had no timing on that one, landed safe in the palms of Yusuf at mid-on
low full toss on the off, drags it wide of midwicket and some lacklustre fielding in the deep allows them to come back for the second
full on the off, driven towards long-off for a single
another length delivery, Karthik cashes in, swinging it hard over long-on, came off the meat and just about managed to clear the fielder, the crowd is on its feet
...to be smacked for six! Karthik's opening up, full, length ball on the off and he bends low and sends it over the bowler's head and long-off for a big six
full outside off, slower one, slog-swept on the bounce towards long-on for a single
Karthik plays a delightful pick-up shot, angling it on the pads, full and he clips it elegantly over deep square leg, beautifully timed, clears the ropes comfortably
slower one again, waits for it to come on and dabs it behind point for a single
the short offcutter, opens the face to tap that behind point for a quick single
there is width on offer and he cuts that down to third man, one more
shortish on middle, tucked into the leg side and steals a quick single
knocks it down in front of cover for a single
short on middle, a long hop and Karthik deals with it well, pulling it away over square leg for a boundary
shortish on leg stump, pushed wide of midwicket for one more
short on middle, pulled away to deep backward square leg
flat and quick outside off, chops it towards point for a single
shortish on middle, punched towards deep midwicket, a single
an attempted inswinging yorker, tries to smack it through midwicket, gets an inside edge onto the pads and has to settle for a single
the shot of the day, superbly done, overpitched yes but Karthik met that with sheer venom, smashing it down the ground past Tait leaving the fielders in the deep no chance to fetch that
too wide, and it;s given by the umpire, and they also steal a run
banged in the short one, Karthik bent low and he initially appeared to be trying to duck but smartly played the upper cut, one to third man
full outside off, bowling from wide of the crease, driven back to the bowler
low full toss, there appeared to be a bit of reverse there, driven hard through midwicket, a couple more
full outside off, tries to drive through the line but gets a thick outside edge behind point, a single
whipped away towards deep midwicket for a single to bring up the team's century
stepping out of his crease to that tossed-up ball, hitting it with the turn is Gambhir as he swings that over midwicket for a boundary
turning in from a good length outside off, punched to extra cover
flighted on leg stump, gets back and pushes it towards long-on
short outside off, moves back and cuts it through point for a single
Gambhir is tempted into playing the slog-sweep, flighted outside off and he eyes midwicket but ends up getting an inside edge as it turns in, two behind square leg
pushed towards long-on for a single to keep the strike
turning in, worked away towards short fine, one more
short on the off, chopped towards point for a single
punched it from the crease wide of midwicket for a single
tickled away towards fine leg for a single
full on the off, driven straight to extra cover
nicely done, waited for it to turn away, Warne slipped that one a little too short, Karthik made room and slapped it through extra cover for a boundary
a bit more air on that one and also kept low as it turned away, beat Karthik who was on the front foot and Ojha took down the stumps but he was well in
sliding it on leg stump, turning away and Karthik defends it watchfully towards point
short outside off, cut away towards deep point for a single

some poor fielding in the deep, drilled hard down the ground, Narwal at long-on fumbles as he slides to his right to stop that, Jhunjhunwala tries to gather it as it rolls towards the ropes, gets there just in time, a couple more
short and wide, steers it to third man for one more, dropping anchor now is the Delhi captain
slower one bowled short on leg stump, fine leg was up and Gambhir tickled that really late and got it past that fielder for a welcome boundary
short of a good length on leg stump, tries to whip that square, is struck on the thighs but gets a single
slower one bowled short outside off, cut away to third man for one more
gets across and Karthik punches that to long-on for a single
short outside off, runs it down to third man for the single
slipped that in quick, shortish on middle, pushed to cover
bends low and paddles that towards fine leg for a couple of runs
tucked into the leg side for a single

no messing around with Warne, flighted and Jadhav comes down the track to launch it into the stands over long-on, though he gets under it he ends up mistiming it and gifts Yusuf Pathan a simple catch, the hand came off the handle there
flighted on middle and turning away, covers it well by moving across and hint and playing it back to the bowler
comes down the track and nudges it through midwicket for a single
tries to force it through the off side but the bat turns in his hand, lobs it just wide of the bowler and gets it to long-on for a single
shortish on the off, punches that towards long-on for a single
full on the pads, a slower one, pitched outside leg, Gambhir tried to heave that over square leg but missed and was struck on the pads, scrambled a leg bye
shortish outside off at 125 kmph, tries to guide it towards third man, misses
turns the face on that straightish ball and gets a single in front of midwicket
short and wide, Jadhav cuts it hard through point, there's no cover in the deep and he gets a boundary
backs away to cut that towards deep cover, a skidding straight ball that
short outside off, cuts it towards short third for a single
whipped from the crease towards square leg where Faiz Fazal misfields, allowing them to come back for the second
skidded onto him there, kept it flat, Gambhir closes the face a touch too early on that and gets a leading edge towards point
slow, really slow through the air, turned away in front of square leg for a single
flighted outside off, comes down the track and drills it to long-off
shortish and he pulls it away through square leg though doesn't time it all too well, still gets a couple
bowls it on a good length outside off, closes the face on it and defends

run-out, Voges gets Collingwood, full outside off, steered just wide of point, Voges dives, collects and returns an excellent throw to Naman Ojha to takes off the bails to find Collingwood short, not sure who called first but Collingwood committed himself to the single and he'll regret it now
held back the length there, comes down the track and punches it wide of mid-off for a quick single, 50 up
pushed into the off side towards cover
bowling in Collingwood's zone in Narwal, full on middle, too straight and he just drives it past mid-on for yet another boundary
nicely done, Tait slips that full, crunched wide of extra cover for a single
Collingwood has the edge in this battle, short and wide, a gift ball, cut away fiercely through point for a boundary
fullish on the off, comes down the track to thrash it through mid-off, misses and Tait and him exchange words
bowled it on a good length on middle, defended into the leg side in front of midwicket and he rushes through for a quick single
bowled at 145.7 kmph, full outside leg and Collingwood is struck on the pads as he tries to drive it through midwicket
what a welcome, short on middle and leg and he pulls it away into the stands over deep square leg, excellent contact
tapped away into the off side towards point
short and wide, too wide, holds its line and is given

Did that hit the helmet? Short outside off, comes down the track and tries to crack that hard, gets an inside edge that beats Ojha the keeper, is heading towards the helmet  behind him but Ojha runs back and dives to push it away, would have cost five runs otherwise
Gambhir is gifted with a full delivery on the off stump and he dispatches it with ease between cover and point for a boundary

Narwal's having a ball, short on the off and Sehwag goes for the pull, a touch too high that and he ends up getting a top edge which is snapped comfortably by Paras Dogra at deep square leg, the openers have been sent back
short outside off, cuts it hard past point towards third man for a single

Narwal ensures the dropped catch doesn't cost him much, full on middle, Warner makes room, probably thinking to drive that but it's far fuller than he expects, almost a yorker and he can't get his bat down in time and is bowled
a bit of a mix-up there, shortish and it's punched wide of the bowler, Voges dives and returns a strong throw to the keeper but Warner has sent Sehwag back in time
tries the reverse-sweep and misses, turns away and he gets into position early but can't connect
ominous signs, shortish on the off, spins away, makes room and thumps that hard over extra cover, plenty of width on offer and he's cashing in
coming from round the wicket, bowls it short on the off, punched off the back foot to extra cover
full and wide, too wide and Sehwag lets it go, given a wide
no restraint this time, full and wide, he stretches to reach it and slices it hard over point for a boundary
short of a length, turns away and Sehwag thinks of cutting it but lets it be at the last moment

Warner's enjoying a bit of luck here, short of a good length, tries to whack it through the off side, ends up slicing it just in front of mid-off, it falls just short of the fielder who fumbles and they get a couple
low full toss outside off, cracked straight to extra cover

dropped, Siddharth Trivedi the culprit, full toss on the off and Warner clubs that towards mid-on, Trivedi runs just a few paces to his right and gets his hands to it but spills a fairly regular chance, how costly will that prove?

banged it short and Sehwag was not fully in control, tried to pull, got it high on the bat and it landed just wide of square leg, a single to the score but it came on to him a lot quicker than he expected
short of a length on the off, no movement there, kept a little low there, Warner tried to pull that past midwicket, mistimed it but earned a run
full on the off, driven hard but straight to mid-off
an opportunity missed, short and wide, makes room to cut but misses, nevertheless Delhi are off to an attacking start
four more, Yusuf kept it flat this time and fired it on leg stump, Sehwag bent low and swept it really fine to find the ropes
this time he can, flighted, comes down the track and sends it into the stands over long-on, nice, clean strike
Sehwag makes room and taps it towards extra cover, can't clear the field there
gave it a bit of air, tossed up on the off, pushed through the line towards long-off for a single
shortish on leg stump, turns towards off and Warner drops it in front of the bowler
all over! Shortish and turns in, Tait charges down the track and tries to swing it over midwicket, misses and Karthik collects another stumping
pulled away to deep midwicket for a single
slaps it down towards long-on for a single
short, pulled away straight o midwicket
the slog-sweep, turning away and he's striking it against the turn but gets it off the meat, McDonald throws himself to his left at deep midwicket but can't get his hands to it, clears him
charges down and tries to smash him over midwicket, gets an outside edge to short third
short of a length on the off, dabbed into the off side
tossed up on the off, played back to the bowler
sharp turn for Ladda, Dogra dances down the track, Ladda holds back the length and gets it to zip away, Dogra misses and loses his shoe in the process, Karthik does the rest
comes down the track to smack him over long-off, ends up slicing it over point for a couple as the fielder in the deep fumbles
rammed back past the bowler to mid-off for a single
short of a good length on the off, defended from the crease to cover
worked away towards deep square leg for a single
smartly guided down to third man for a single
short of a length on middle, pushed off the back foot to extra cover
moves away from the batsman, moves back to cut, misses
the googly, turned in as he was shaping for a cut, he didn't pick it and was struck on the pads, was going down the leg side
slapped down to long-off for a single
slashes it towards short third on the bounce
Tait is keen to make amends for his performance with the ball, tossed up and he takes it on the full to smash it over wide long-on
short on the off, slaps it straight back to the bowler
turned away, eased towards deep cover for a single
short and pulled away to wide long-on for a single
slower one bowled short, punched from the crease towards deep cover for a single
driven down the ground to long-on for a single
Warner grabs his fourth catch, added to that run out, full on the off and it's lofted straight into the palms of long-off where Warner takes a dolly, Whatacatchaaaaa!
slower one bowled full outside off, makes room to loft him over extra cover, gets an inside edge to short fine for a single
swung away over midwicket into the deep for a couple of runs
full toss on middle, makes room and drives it past extra cover but Gambhir dives full length to his right to keep them down to a single
low full toss on middle, digs it out into the leg side
targeting the blockhole, dug out in front of cover for a single
full on the off, does well to squeeze that through point and short third for a boundary
slower one bowled short, pulled away towards deep midwicket for a couple of runs
full on the off, tries to drive but ends up digging it out in front of the bowler
Dogra sends that over long-off, flighted outside off, he takes it off a length and strikes it cleanly over the ropes
shortish on the off, played back to the bowler
cracked down the ground to long-off for a single
flighted, gets outside the line to sweep it over square leg, is struck on the pads
flighted outside off, turns in just a hint, left alone, given a wide
short on middle, long hop, moves back and pulls it over midwicket for a boundary
shortish outside off, cuts it straight to point
gets on the front foot and defends that to point

there's no stopping Delhi today, Warner is on a roll, driven to him at mid-on and they rush for a single, he collects, takes aim and throws down the stumps at the non-striker's end to find Warne miles short
the googly but misdirected, wide down the leg side
worked away through square leg for a single

Delhi are shutting Rajasthan out quickly here, flighted, a lot more air this time, full outside off and Voges goes for the slog-sweep, he's aiming at midwicket but gets a a top edge to long-on where Warner makes no mistake
shortish on the off, swatted wide of long-off for a couple of runs
flighted outside off, driven back to the bowler who hurls it back down the pitch
short of a length outside off, turned away to just beat the outside edge
gets forward and defends with bat close to pad, was it pad first though? Had it been, it was a close call though they're not showing any replay
keeps it flat and targets middle, not much turn for him as much as Mishra, defended back down the pitch
flighted on middle, gets forward and drives it down to long-on for a single
tucks it down behind square for a single
spins away and guides it towards point
driven through extra cover into the deep for a single
gets on the front foot and drops it in front of point
pushed off the front foot to extra cover
bowling it from wide of the crease, gets outside the line and defends

is it all over for Rajasthan? Short on the off, slow through the air and he waits for that to turn away and slams that flat and straight to Warner at long-on, he could have struck that anywhere, had plenty of time to do so but picked out the fielder
slips in the googly, turned away to square leg for a single
short one, they need to bowl more of those against him, banged it short and he was late to react, was struck on the shoulder, that clocked 140
another one, short and wide again and he cuts it to beat point and the fielder in the deep who has no chance running to his left
full on middle, driven straight to midwicket
short and wide, poor delivery and he slashes it with contempt through point, remember he was dropped on 2
full on the off, driven down the ground to long-on
slower one dropped short, pulled wide of deep midwicket for a couple of runs
Yusuf warming up nicely here, flighted on middle, he takes his left foot out of the way and swings that over deep midwicket for yet another maximum
full on middle and wham! Yusuf slams that over the bowler's head and into the stands
pushed back to the bowler

dropped, difficult to call it that but Collingwood did get his hands to it, a lethargic chip by Yusuf who gets no timing on it, running in from long-off, Collingwood covers good distance but fails to hold on while diving to his left
low full toss on middle, pushed in front of midwicket for a single
full outside off, moves away and stretches to dig it out towards cover
short of a good length, tries to turn it away into the leg side, gets an inside edge onto his pads
fullish on middle, crunched towards mid-off
short on middle and Voges cashes in, pulling it with disdain over midwicket for a boundary
bowls it on a good length on middle, Yusuf tries to pick him through the leg side, gets a thick inside edge behind square for a single
chops it down towards point, calls for a single but Yusuf isn't interested
slower one on the pads, tries to tickle it fine, flicks the pads but Karthik does well to prevent the single
slower one bowled full, pushed away into the off side
short of a good length on middle, defended into the off side

run-out, slower one, worked through midwicket for a single but it's during an ill-planned second that all goes wrong, Voges calls, Jhunjhunwala responds but is then sent back and it's too late, Ladda returns a good throw to Karthik who takes the bails off to find him miles short
flighted on middle, driven back to the bowler
quicker through the air but misdirected, down the leg side, given a wide
pushed it wide of mid-on for a single

lovely delivery, sweet vengeance for Mishra, came from wide of the crease and looped it into the right-hander at around middle and off, got it to turn away sharply as Ojha stepped forward to defend, it kissed the outside edge and Karthik held on to a simple catch, Simon Taufel the umpire had no doubt, a big wicket for Delhi
Ojha continuing from where he left off the previous game, short and wide, cut away over point for another boundary
short and Ojha cashes in, turns away, he moves away and slaps it wide of cover to the ropes
shortish on middle, pushed wide of midwicket for a single
tried to be a little cheeky there, short of a good length, made room and chopped it just in time wide of the keeper
low full toss outside off, moves across and drags it through midwicket for another boundary
picked the slower one this time and thumped it into the stands over long-on, landed on a length and he smacked it hard
back to normal pace, 128.9 kmph, full on middle, driven straight to mid-on
fullish on middle, pushed back on the bounce to the bowler
legcutter again, shortish, moves away and he goes for the cut, misses
full on the pads and pushed to mid-on
full on the pads and clipped to deep midwicket
good shot, length ball outside off and Ojha makes a bit of room and slices it wide of backward point, in the air and in the gap
plays a nice short arm pull and finds deep square leg
nice stump to stump line, he pushes it back to the bowler
the slower legcutter again, pushed towards cover

another one down! Maharoof gets it to move in to the left-hander, Fazal moves across to drive it through the leg side, misses and catches him plumb in front of middle, it was the slower legcutter he failed to pick
gets forward and pushes it towards mid-on
guided down to third man for a single

gone! Warner takes a brilliant catch running behind from mid-off, Lumb just chips that over the bowler's head, Warner runs back, stretches and appears to fumble at first but manages to just about hold on with his left hand as he falls forward, early setback for Rajasthan
short of a good length outside off, cut straight to point
